recognize_zh: 低倍下一條粉紅色玻璃樣變的血管由上方垂直穿入一個小而萎縮的生發中心，形狀像插著棒子的棒棒糖（lollipop），外圍小淋巴球呈同心圓排列；「棒棒糖病灶」是透明血管型 Castleman 病的經典考點。
features: Hyalinized, eosinophilic vessel radially penetrating a small regressed germinal center, forming a lollipop configuration
Germinal center small and lymphocyte-depleted, composed of endothelial cells and follicular dendritic cells
Expanded mantle zone of small mature lymphocytes arranged concentrically around the germinal center
Dense background of small lymphocytes with increased interfollicular small vessels
No atypical large cell sheets or necrosis
describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows a lymphoid follicle with a small, atrophic germinal center into which a hyalinized, eosinophilic vessel penetrates radially, producing the characteristic lollipop appearance. The germinal center is lymphocyte-depleted and composed of endothelial and follicular dendritic cells. It is surrounded by an expanded mantle zone of small mature lymphocytes in concentric layers, and the interfollicular region contains numerous small vessels. Findings are consistent with unicentric Castleman disease, hyaline-vascular type.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles have large germinal centers with polarized dark and light zones, tingible-body macrophages and no hyalinized penetrating vessels.
AITL has regressed follicles and prominent vessels but shows a polymorphous infiltrate of atypical clear T cells expressing PD1/CD10/CXCL13 with expanded extrafollicular FDC meshworks.
IgG4-related disease has abundant interfollicular IgG4+ plasma cells with an increased IgG4:IgG ratio and eosinophils.
HIV-related follicular involution may form lollipop-like follicles but occurs with follicle lysis, clinical HIV infection and sometimes HHV8-associated changes.
